notes.title: Strange Hunting Grounds Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
🎉 Strange Hunting Grounds Demo Now Available! 🎮
Hello, this is the Strange Hunting Grounds development team.

We're excited to announce that the demo version of Strange Hunting Grounds is now available on Steam!


🕹️ Play the Demo Today!
In this demo, you can experience the core gameplay and new content from the full version ahead of its release.
Explore the unique world of Strange Hunting Grounds and enjoy hunting in your own style!

New monsters and hunting grounds

Improved combat system

Various quality-of-life features based on user feedback

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836435/1c7c3588c2a36ca1c50e0b330cd3bae55d49598d.png"]
📅 Full Game Launching in July!
We’re working hard to make the full game even better, using your valuable feedback from the demo.
The official release is planned for July!
After playing the demo, feel free to share your thoughts and suggestions in our community.
Your input will help us make Strange Hunting Grounds even more fun!


🙏 Thank You for Your Support
Thank you so much for your continued interest and encouragement.
We promise to do our best to meet your expectations and deliver a great gaming experience.

Thank you!


[hr][/hr]💡 Marketer TIP from Palpal
Announcing the demo is a great way to boost curiosity and excitement among players.

Use action-oriented phrases like "Play the Demo Today!" to encourage immediate engagement.

Actively asking for community feedback strengthens your image as a developer who listens.

Clearly state the full game release date and highlight what’s new or improved in the full version compared to the demo.

If you need any other versions or further tweaks, just let me know!

notes.title: Announcing a New Beginning! – From the Strange Hunting Ground Development Team
notes.content:
🎉 Announcing a New Beginning! – From the Strange Hunting Ground Development Team
Hello, this is the development team of Strange Hunting Ground.

First of all, we would like to sincerely thank everyone who has shown interest in our game.

Service Schedule & Development Background
As many of you may already know, Strange Hunting Ground is a re-skinned project following the end of service for Survival Academy.
Originally, we planned to launch the new game in September 2024, but in order to deliver a higher level of quality and more enjoyable experience, development took longer than expected, and the schedule has been pushed into this year.

Unexpected Publisher Withdrawal
During development, we also faced an unexpected situation: our publisher abruptly withdrew from business.
Due to this, we have not yet fully received all rights to the game, and this has caused additional delays in our service schedule.

A Message to Our Users
We understand that the end of service for Survival Academy may have caused disappointment and inconvenience for many of you.
We sincerely apologize for this.

With Strange Hunting Ground, we are doing our utmost to reflect your previous feedback and to deliver a more enjoyable and polished game experience.

Upcoming Plans
Nintendo Switch Version: Released in April 2025
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836435/1f5ef71491bf59bb88c896b479624e268cd17725.png

Global Console & Mobile Versions: Scheduled for release in June 2025

Steam Version: Scheduled for release in July 2025

Ongoing Updates & New Content Announcements: We will continue to share news and updates through this announcement section.

We look forward to your valuable feedback and suggestions.
If you have any questions or comments, please feel free to leave them in the community!

Once Again, Thank You Very Much.
We will do our best to meet your expectations
and to deliver an even better gaming experience.

Thank you.
